passages.quote:
Guidance for local authorities and other waste collectors on prioritising their waste collection services if there is unexpected pressure on resources. Local authorities are encouraged to maintain waste collection services as much as possible.

This is non-statutory guidance to help local authorities maintain services during emergency situations, such as:

extreme weather events

prolonged industrial action

infectious disease outbreaks

This guidance applies to English local authorities only.
